title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew made with jerk seasoned chicken, onions, garlic, and a hint of coconut milk.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
4. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
5. Stir in jerk seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
6. Add coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
7. Reduce heat to low and let simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
8. Serve hot, garnished with quaintly flaky crusty bread.
